QuestInfo.name: Excavation Impossible 2
QuestInfo.0: You came to #b#p9390353##k to find out more about #bTristan's Sword#k, but he seems to think you're going to help. See what he needs.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9390353##k didn't say anything about #bTristan's Sword#k, but he might get off the subject of #bthe equipment#k if you butter him up a little. Hunt #bDrakes#k to find more equipment.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: #b#p9390352##k thanked you for getting his equipment back, and offered some info on #bTristan's Sword#k.\r\n

0.1: I'm guessing you heard about it from #b#p1101004##k. Look, I know you can hunt a Copper Drake or two and think you're hot stuff, but #bTristan's Sword#k isn't just any item.
0.2: Anyway, all I know about #bTristan's Sword#k ended at #b#m105020000##k. Hm, let's see...
0.3: Once you get the key, get it to #bMudry#k.

yes.0: Get as many Key Fragments as you can. The more, the better.

no.0: I didn't know you were so kind!

yes.0: You already got sixty of them? Incredible! You helped me so much!

item.0: I thought so. #bDrakes#k are pretty scary monsters.
